summary:
Head 914798afa49a96c12fc63c1a0d42a6126172bd41 (REFS-KIT) is exactly my ruling and nothing more. Risk tier 1 (spike code only; no kit or gate file). 
1. Commit contents: it touches only spikes/netcode-proof/check.mjs (+15 -2) and check.test.mjs (+11). Applying the ruling's 3 check.mjs replacements and 1 check.test.mjs replacement to 63cc7c3's files (each old text found once) gives 914798a's blobs byte for byte. Commits 63cc7c3..63afbbf touched only .checkpoints/. The ruling's two plan.md replacements on 63cc7c3^ give 63cc7c3's plan.md exactly (whole file equal, so nothing else changed), and 914798a's plan.md equals it. `text` is a `let`, so the reassignment works.
2. Evidence (.gate/refs-kit/): refs-self.log shows refs PASS on 1268 files with the line naming §4.9's exception, and self 78 of 78. The fixed/ copy equals 914798a. The P1, P2 and P3 check.mjs copies differ from 914798a only at line 1862, exactly the ruling's three plants, and their check.test.mjs equals 914798a's. I re-ran the two refs tests myself on all four copies: fixed 2 of 2; P1, P2 and P3 each 1 pass and 1 fail, the failing test the new one, with the diffs the ruling predicts. gate-no-smoke.log: GATE PASS (5a skipped by --no-smoke). counted.log: HEAD 63cc7c3, 20:34:34-20:48:30 UTC, all 11 steps PASS, exit 0 (test 538 + 616 passed, 0 failed; self 78/78; redact 10/10). I reproduced its diff hash: `git diff 63cc7c3 914798a -- .` in spikes/netcode-proof gives 56351922a90c472552253279be0490b95d56bdb6b9aa5ae4bed38ec30504ab9e, the same as main-run.sh line 42 (`git diff HEAD -- .`). The untracked hash is the empty input. So the counted run ran exactly the content 914798a commits. CI on 914798a (gh api check-runs): gate, toolchain and smoke all success (20:36 UTC). The cursor and claude app suites show as queued with no runs: app noise, not a failure. The kit files on main 53272a1 have 2 and 6 'spikes/' strings, and 0 once spikes/netcode-proof/results/ is taken out, so the exception fits the real files.
3. Before the merge of main: nothing on this head needs to change. Branch tip ed3d9fd adds only the checkpoint card after 914798a. A trial merge-tree against origin/main shows one conflict, docs/STATUS.md, which the ruling's step 2 already gives to merge_main_53.py (tracked). Main touches no spikes/ file. The kit files arrive only with the merge, so the exception has run on the real tree in no run yet: that is step 2's check.mjs whole run. Notes: /home/user/Shamble-Frontlines/.checkpoints/netcode-proof-test/advisor-refs-kit-head.md.

So the exception's code path has been proven only by the unit test and the plants, not yet on the real files. In memory, both real files hold no 'spikes/' text once the results folder is taken out.
findings.fix: No change to this head. Step 2's check.mjs whole run on the merged tree must show refs PASS on the §4.9 line, with the kit files present (git ls-files counts them).

conditions: Step 2 (the merge of main) follows the ruling as written: `git merge --no-ff --no-commit origin/main` in the main folder (allowed: main's reviewed rules), merge_main_53.py for the one conflict, docs/STATUS.md, and no other change in the merge commit.

go_merge: Go for step 2: the merge of main 53272a1 may proceed on top of the branch tip (ed3d9fd, which adds only the checkpoint card after 914798a). This is the advisor's check of a spike-branch head, not a merge to main.
